questions.q: Why does Srđan joke about seven months in a coma and gold?
o: He tells about athlete Betty Robinson who woke from a coma
He tells about his own illness
He tells about his wife who ran races
questions.e: In the video: "bila sedam meseci u komi" — was in a coma for seven months.

questions.q: What conclusion does Srđan draw from Betty's story?
o: It's important to get enough sleep
questions.e: In the video: "vidiš koliko je bitno da se čovek naspava" — — you see how important it is for a person to get some sleep.

questions.q: How did his wife react to the joke about the tree man's death?
o: She was outraged: how can you
questions.e: In the video: "Kaže ona: kako možeš?" — — She says: how can you?

questions.q: What did the authorities propose against skipping school?
o: A fine of 1500 euros for parents
questions.e: In the video: "tako što će roditelj da plati kaznu 1500 evra" — — by making the parent pay a fine of 1500 euros.

questions.q: According to Srđan's joke, how does a second child differ from the first?
questions.e: In the video: "nosi iznošenu odeću i igra se izdrndanim igračkama" — — wears hand-me-down clothes and plays with battered toys.

questions.q: What does the son do when drinking juice through a straw?
questions.e: In the video: "stavi je u usta i podiže obrvu" — — puts it in his mouth and raises his eyebrow.

questions.q: What happened with Bane when Srđan won an award?
questions.e: In the video: "Bane potpisao za Čelzi." — — Bane signed for Chelsea.

questions.q: What happened to Ivana at the basketball game?
o: She's chewing gum peeled off a chair
questions.e: In the video: "Odlepila je sa stolice u sportskoj hali žvaku i žvaće." — — she peeled gum off a chair in the sports hall and chews it.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ja dve stvari *mrzim*
questions.e: mrzeti — to hate: «mrzim» = I hate.

questions.q: Ali koliko je 20 *centimetara*
questions.e: centimetar — centimeter; «20 centimetara» = 20 centimeters.

questions.q: Pronađen ugljenisan *leš*
questions.e: leš — corpse; ugljenisan — charred.

questions.q: *maltretiraš* ceo grad
questions.e: maltretirati — to torment, harass.

questions.q: Ne *očekuj* previše od mene
questions.e: očekivati — to expect; «ne očekuj» = don't expect.

questions.q: kad skačemo *udalj* na fizičkom
questions.e: skok udalj — long jump.

questions.q: nema neke *euforije* kad se rodi
questions.e: euforija — euphoria; gen. euforije.

questions.q: svojim *perifernim* vidom vidim siluetu
questions.e: periferni vid — peripheral vision.

questions.q: izjavila je: ljudi se sve ređe odlučuju za ___ dete
questions.e: «odlučiti se za» + acc.; dete is neuter: prvo dete.

questions.q: Moj mlađi brat ima tri ___
questions.e: After tri the noun takes the -e form: tri fotke.

questions.q: nekadašnjem ___ srpske fudbalske reprezentacije
questions.e: Dative together with nekadašnjem: kapitenu.

questions.q: Ti odmotaš ___, a antenica stoji
questions.e: Direct object, acc.: pelenu.

questions.q: Ja sam kao mali bio ___ za pisanje pesmica
questions.e: A man is speaking: bio + talentovan (masc.).

questions.q: Ja sam kao mali bio talentovan ___ pisanje pesmica
questions.e: talentovan za + acc. — talented at something.

questions.q: I nešto na šta me još nisu ___
questions.e: Perfective, masc. pl.: nisu upozorili — haven't warned.

questions.q: Ali ja nisam odustao od svojih ___
questions.e: odustati od + gen. pl.: snova.
